vllm._comment: Optional — defaults for auto-generated vLLM profiles. image overrides the stock vllm/vllm-openai tag; image_gpt_oss overrides the gpt-oss image. Set moe_backend to "" to omit --moe-backend entirely and let vLLM autoselect (recommended on GB10/sm_121, where the Marlin MoE kernel miscomputes for some architectures).
vllm._comment_serve: serve_command is normally omitted — it is derived from the image, because whether an explicit 'vllm serve' is needed is a property of the image's entrypoint, not of the model. vllm-openai images serve on entrypoint (derives to ""); images that exec their arguments, such as eugr/spark-vllm, need 'vllm serve'. Set explicitly to override, including "" to add nothing.

alerts._comment: All keys optional — omit this section entirely to keep defaults. webhook_url falls back to the DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL env var; interval_s falls back to ALERT_CHECK_INTERVAL.

sites_discovery._comment: The Dashboards tab finds running web UIs itself: every non-loopback TCP listener plus every Kubernetes NodePort gets one HTTP GET, and a port earns a card only if it answers with an HTML page. Ports answering JSON/plain text are kept as kind=api behind a toggle. All keys optional.

sites._comment: Optional overlay on discovery, not the list itself. An entry with a port renames/describes/groups that discovered port (curation beats the page's <title>). An entry with a verbatim url pins something discovery cannot see — a UI on another host. Ports resolve against app.sites_base → app.host → the request host; scheme defaults to http. Configured entries stay visible even when down, so a dashboard you care about never silently disappears.
